title: Grateful Dead Live at Cal Expo, Building A on 1969-11-21
lineage: SBD > MR > (Cass in set 1, not set 2) > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with mixed audio quality (first half poor, second half excellent) captures a high‑energy 1969 show highlighted by Pigpen’s dominance and standout Good Lovin' and High Time performances.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its fiery second set – tight Good Lovin', an uplifting China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider, and a superb High Time – with Ron “Pigpen” McKernan stealing the spotlight on four songs. While the first six tracks suffer from weak audio fidelity, the latter half sounds crisp and balances the band's lively playing, making it a worthwhile listen for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated very high (strong performances, especially Pigpen) while recording quality is split; weighted average yields a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First six tracks are poor‑quality audio despite a decent mix; the remaining seven tracks are high‑quality with clear separation and strong instrument definition.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set shines with tight transitions and elevated energy; first half suffers from audio issues but the musicianship remains strong throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Fat guitar sound noted, bridging Live Dead psychedelia and Workingman's Dead country feel.
band_member_comments.Keys: Snakey, almost Dylanesque keyboard weaving highlighted on Me And My Uncle.
